title: ExecutionFinished
description: Runner Worker -> Core Backend (Execution Event Listener). Queue: execution.events. Carries RAW runner output only; the worker never decides PASSED/FAILED. The Execution Orchestrator validates junitXml and is the only writer of status (ASR-3, ADR-006). A message for an execution that is already terminal is ignored (idempotent by executionId).

outcome.description: COMPLETED = sandbox exited on its own; TIMEOUT = killed at the time limit; RESOURCE_LIMIT = killed for memory (OOM); ERROR = the worker could not run the sandbox
